text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 429s observed in europe cluster (eu-west-2) since ~12:34 UTC. 429 rate trending 18% on proxy-edge-1, spike concentrated on embeddings and vector-search endpoints. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/traffic/eu-spike :rotating_light:

maria: seeing the same in logs. p50 token latency up from 120ms -> 580ms for embeddings path. A few 503s (approx 2%) at the model pool level.

pagerbot: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/alerts/2812345678 — auto-detected tenant hot list attached (top offenders: tenant-938, tenant-221, tenant-legacy-search).

maria: first mitigation idea: surgical per-tenant soft-quota reductions for the 3 hot tenants + flip shadow throttle on region to test impact. thinking rules: reduce steady qps by 30% for those tenants, keep burst window but clamp tokens to 512.

tim: +1 to shadow throttle. also propose disabling vector-search-beta flag for eu cluster (non-critical) to cut downstream model calls. Can we flip that at the edge?

ade: we can patch routing config via the proxy feature flags: /featureflags toggle vector-search-beta --env eu-west-2. I'll prepare the command. Also suggest temporary fallback to smaller model variant for non-critical embeddings jobs (quantized-ggml-6b).

maria: do the flag toggle and tenant soft-quota first. Order: 1) enable shadow throttle (doesn't drop, just samples and reports), 2) soft-quota -30% on offending tenants, 3) disable vector flag. Monitor 429% and p50. If 429s don't drop after 5m escalate to full reject.

ade: running commands now:
```bash
# enable shadow throttle in eu region
./infractl regions throttle enable --region eu-west-2 --mode shadow --rate 0.7
# reduce tenant steady quota (example)
./infractl tenants update-quotas --tenant tenant-938 --steady-mult 0.7
./infractl tenants update-quotas --tenant tenant-221 --steady-mult 0.7
./infractl tenants update-quotas --tenant tenant-legacy-search --steady-mult 0.7
# flip feature flag
./ff-toggle --env eu-west-2 vector-search-beta off
```

maria: applied. shadow throttle is ON (sampling), quotas patched, FF toggled. Watching metrics.

pagerbot: [metric snapshot] 1m after changes: 429 down from 18% -> 12%, p50 down to 420ms, 503 steady at 2.1%. Shadow throttle sampling shows 40% of sampled requests would have been throttled for tenant-938.

tim: that's encouraging. next step if trend continues: convert shadow throttle -> soft reject for top 10% of offending requests (non-critical route only) and divert heavy traffic to cheaper model pool. We'll need a canary for that.

ade: prepping canary route now. plan: route 5% of matching traffic to quantized-ggml-6b pool and soft-reject another 10% at edge. command:
```bash
./router update-rule --region eu-west-2 --rule reduce-heavy-embeds --canary 0.05 --divert-model quantized-ggml-6b --soft-reject 0.10
```

maria: do it. also notify SLO owners and Support: support-runbook link https://confluence.redwood/internal/sre/live-mitigation-runbook. Add note: potential customer-visible throttling for tenant-938 and tenant-221 — prepare proactive outreach if errors >15% for >10m.

jordan: oncall note: I'll be taking first handoff in 30m. If we move to hard rejects, page me directly. Also confirm that billing alerts suppressed for these throttles to avoid false alarms.

pagerbot: canary deployed. 5% diverted -> quantized-ggml-6b. Soft-reject 10% enabled. Immediate metrics: 10m window: 429s down to 9.5%, p50 280ms, 95th token latency 2.3s -> 1.1s.

maria: good. I'm going to keep the FF off and quotas in place. We should keep shadow throttle on for another 20m to gather more signal.

tim: quick observation — logs show a small spike of retries from tenant-legacy-search (~3%) post-FF toggle, probably from client side retries. We should watch for client-side retry storms and consider increasing retry-backoff guidance.

ade: added a quick note to API docs and support snippet: "If you see increased 429s after today 12:30 UTC, we are enacting temporary throttles; please implement exponential backoff (max jitter)".

pagerbot: alerting: incident severity lowered to S2 (mitigation in place). Paging suppressed for further 429 noise for now.

maria: decision log: (1) shadow throttle + soft quotas applied (2) vector-search-beta disabled in eu region (3) 5% canary diverted to quantized-ggml-6b, 10% soft-reject for heavy requests. Keep monitoring for 30m. If 429 < 5% and p50 < 200ms, we'll start restoring quotas and flip FF on in a controlled canary.

jordan: acknowledged. I'll take over monitoring and oncall after 30m. Anyone who needs to escalate, DM me. Sending a short incident summary to #incidents in 15m. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks team, leaving console watch to jordan. Logging final note in incident tracker: https://incidents.redwood/internal/incidents/2812345678

pagerbot: last update at +25m: 429 rate 7.2%, p50 240ms, 503 1.8%. Keeping this thread open for handoff notes.

jordan: handoff accepted. I'll keep an eye and roll back quotas in a phased way if metrics stay stable. Handoff ETA: 30m from original alert start.

maria: done from my side, handing to jordan. :wave:
